qAndA.answer: The rocks form a small memorial for 'Leopold,' who passed away on July 20th, 2019.

qAndA.answer: He mentions that the road is a little rough and suggests taking the next right turn after the wooden Mountain Pond sign for an easier access.

qAndA.answer: He didn't hear any songbirds during his previous visit to the Adirondacks last year, suggesting a possible decline in bird populations. He is happy to see them return, which suggests a positive change in the environment.

qAndA.answer: He mentions that he has kayaks and plans to go kayaking on the lake later in the day. This suggests a focus on enjoying nature and outdoor activities.
